The WRX STI is laser-focused on handling, with a track-tuned suspension
that features standard inverted front struts and aluminum front lower
control arms for low unsprung weight—an attribute further enhanced by
its lightweight 19-inch alloy wheels. And it’s all underpinned by Subaru
Symmetrical AWD with Driver Controlled Center Differential, front and rear
limited-slip differentials and Active Torque Vectoring, so you can hit your
apexes and nail your exits with control, precision and speed.
In the WRX STI, the synergy between driver and car is unmistakable.
You’ll feel an invigorating sense of control, thanks to its ultra-quick
13.3:1 steering ratio and rigid unibody chassis. Its powerful Brembo®
high-performance braking system features 6-piston front and 2-piston
rear monoblock calipers and cross-drilled rotors to stop you with
authority and reduced brake fade. And the signature rear wing of
the WRX STI adds downforce for more stability at higher speeds.
